<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 2"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Stonebound Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4377) <actions string="" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Sky King's Tomb</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
<trait label="Dedication" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=41" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown](/Sources.aspx?ID=210) pg. 83

**Archetype** [Stonebound](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=210)

**Prerequisites**
Constitution 14

</column>

---

You bind yourself to the very essence of stone. You become trained in [Plane of Earth](/Planes.aspx?ID=5) [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) and learn the [Terran](/Languages.aspx?ID=22) language. If you are already trained in Plane of Earth Lore, you become trained in a skill of your choice. If you already speak Terran, you learn a common language of your choice. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level.

**Special** You cannot select another dedication feat until you have gained two other feats from the stonebound archetype.

<title level="2">Stonebound Dedication leads to...</title>
[Elemental Existence](/Feats.aspx?ID=4378), [Living Stone](/Feats.aspx?ID=4384), [Rocky Flesh](/Feats.aspx?ID=4383), [Statue](/Feats.aspx?ID=4382), [Stone Blood](/Feats.aspx?ID=4380), [Stone Guardian](/Feats.aspx?ID=4379), [Stonebound Magic](/Feats.aspx?ID=4381)
